assets.alt: Seven-step workflow: gather context with the PM, capture answers, write a spec file, build in real product code, generate the handover with skills and agents, developers build from it, and a 30 minute planning meeting. Two steps are marked as needing confirmation.
assets.fills: Diagram for /p4-dam, under "Key decisions" or "How I used AI".
assets.notes: Two [CONFIRM] steps: how Claude Code is used, how the snapshot is generated. Remove tags once answered.

assets.alt: Diagram of the Budibase case study: a paid study with 25 users found testing and debugging was the biggest pain, four design changes addressed it, and Discord complaints fell from 8 to 10 a month to zero within a month and stayed there three months later, with no post-launch test. Budibase later launched agents that work with automations.
assets.fills: Diagram for /budibase-automations, before "Design changes".
assets.notes: States that no post-launch test was run. Does not claim agents are built on the redesign.

assets.alt: Three evidence chains from the CityFibre case study: the homepage first screen led to 90% more postcode checks, the portal research led to satisfaction rising from 4 out of 10 to 8 out of 10, and the design system led to send-backs falling from 15% to 5%.
assets.fills: Diagram for /cityfibre, after "Role and team".
assets.notes: Absolute postcode counts are not on the page; the diagram says so only through the Google Analytics caption.
